episodes.title: Chapter One: An Unkindness in London
episodes.summary: As Jessie's nightmares grow worse, Bea accepts Dr. Watson's job offer to investigate four kidnapped babies — and receives some unexpectedly posh help.

episodes.title: Chapter Two: The Ghosts of 221B
episodes.summary: Broke and in trouble, Bea reluctantly partners with Jessie to find out who's stealing children's teeth. Spike spies on Watson and Sherlock Holmes.

episodes.title: Chapter Three: Ipsissimus
episodes.summary: A gruesome murder sends Bea and her crew undercover at a country estate to determine whether the killer is part of a secret paranormal society.

episodes.title: Chapter Four: Both the Needle and the Knife
episodes.summary: Jessie comes face to face with Inspector Lestrade at a crime scene, Bea plays cat and mouse with Watson, and Leo feels torn over his life at the palace.

episodes.title: Chapter Five: Students of the Unhallowed Arts
episodes.summary: Bea discovers more about her mother's long-ago connection to Sherlock and Watson, while Billy contemplates revenge after a brutal reminder of his past.

episodes.title: Chapter Six: Hieracium Snowdoniense
episodes.summary: Bea suspects a spate of stolen body parts links to an old case. Jessie approaches Sherlock about her nightmares. Leo makes a stand for his future.

episodes.title: Chapter Seven: The Ecstasy of Death
episodes.summary: After demanding the truth from Watson, Bea joins a plan to catch the Linen Man. Jessie fights her fears. Spike scrambles to keep his friends together.

episodes.title: Chapter Eight: The Ecstasy of Life
episodes.summary: As London descends into chaos, Bea and her crew head underground, where together they face untold terror in a dangerous quest to locate the rip.
